description: This file defines the main application router component for a React web application. It sets up route definitions with animated page transitions, including public pages (landing, login), protected dashboard pages (overview, model-a, settings), and a catch-all for page not found. It imports components from React Router, framer-motion for animations, and project-specific page components.

methods.name: Page
methods.description: A React functional component that wraps page content with motion animations for route transitions.
